description: This file declares the NSSCertDatabase class and related structures for managing NSS certificate stores, including certificate listing, trust management, import/export, and observer notifications within the Chromium project.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabase
classes.description: Manages NSS certificate stores, including listing, trust settings, import/export, and observer notifications.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabase::Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to receive notifications about certificate database changes.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabase::CertInfo
classes.description: Holds an NSS certificate along with additional metadata such as trust and storage info.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabase::ImportCertFailure
classes.description: Represents a failure to import a certificate, including the certificate and error code.

methods.name: ListCerts
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of unique certificates in the database.

methods.name: ListCertsInSlot
methods.description: Retrieves certificates from a specific slot.

methods.name: ListCertsInfo
methods.description: Retrieves certificates along with additional info, with an option to include/exclude NSS roots.

methods.name: GetSystemSlot
methods.description: Returns the system-wide key slot (Chrome OS only).

methods.name: GetPublicSlot
methods.description: Returns the default public key slot.

methods.name: GetPrivateSlot
methods.description: Returns the default private key slot.

methods.name: ListModules
methods.description: Lists cryptographic modules, optionally only writable ones.

methods.name: SetCertTrust
methods.description: Sets trust bits for a certificate.

methods.name: ImportFromPKCS12
methods.description: Imports certificates and keys from a PKCS#12 blob.

methods.name: ExportToPKCS12
methods.description: Exports certificates and keys to a PKCS#12 blob.

methods.name: FindRootInList
methods.description: Finds the root certificate in a list.

methods.name: ImportUserCert
methods.description: Imports a user certificate.

methods.name: ImportCACerts
methods.description: Imports CA certificates with specified trust.

methods.name: ImportServerCert
methods.description: Imports server certificates with trust settings.

methods.name: GetCertTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust bits for a certificate.

methods.name: DeleteCertAndKey
methods.description: Deletes a certificate and its private key.

methods.name: DeleteCertAndKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a certificate and key.

methods.name: IsUntrusted
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is explicitly untrusted.

methods.name: IsWebTrustAnchor
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is trusted for web navigation.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is stored in a read-only slot.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is stored in hardware-backed storage.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for certificate database changes.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer.
